cc:Work.dc:title: FlexBox - RoundedTrapezoidBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Trapezoid box with rounded vertical edges.
The x and y measurements are for a trapazoid with sharp corners. The radii cut the corners so the actual width is smaller for all trapazoids except rectangles.
![Two boxes side by side](static/samples/RoundedTrapezoidBox-2.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes RoundedTrapezoidBox --x_front 120 --x_back 160 --y 100 --h 60 --top closed --wall_pieces 4 --outside 0 --DoveTail_size 4 --Flex_distance 0.7 --thickness 3 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes RoundedTrapezoidBox --x_front --x_back --h --top --wall_pieces --outside --DoveTail_size --Flex_distance --reference --labels
